name: Augmentor
author: Manolo's DeepSeek Harness (preinstalled first-party add-on)
description: The ResonantOS Augmentor: Manolo's DeepSeek Harness, the product's one first-party agent. Dispatches chat completions to a local DeepSeek-compatible (OpenAI) service through a host-mediated loopback service. Preinstalled and pre-granted.

tools.name: augmentor.status
tools.description: Read the local DeepSeek-compatible runtime health and availability.

tools.name: augmentor.run_task
tools.description: Run a delegated prompt through the local DeepSeek-compatible runtime and return the completion (prepare/propose — a human approves the commit).
